sources.cite: Microsoft Learn, Azure Policy exemption structure
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: an exemption exempts a resource hierarchy or resource from evaluation; category 'Waiver: the non-compliance state of the resource is temporarily accepted' (and can exclude a resource from one or more definitions in an initiative, not the whole initiative), 'Mitigated: the policy intent is met through another method'; expiresOn, after which the exemption 'is no longer honored' but is kept for record; scope at or under the assignment scope; policyDefinitionReferenceId is an array naming the initiative's definitions exempted; the creator needs policyExemptions/write and the exempt/Action verb on the assignment. The RequestDisallowedByPolicy error and that RBAC roles cannot override a deny effect are from memory of the Azure Policy documentation (to verify).

brief.situation: You are the Azure architect for Lindqvist Foods, a fictional food producer. Tonight the SAP team builds the production HANA VMs (M64s) in the new SAP landing zone subscription, which sits under the Corp management group. The deployment fails at once. The SAP team needs the VMs by 20:30 to install HANA overnight for tomorrow's go-live rehearsal.
handover: The Corp management group carries the 'corp-baseline' initiative: tagging, allowed locations, and an allowed VM sizes list that predates SAP.
The governance board owns corp-baseline; its chair, Ana Ruiz, is on call tonight.
howItWorks: The terminal shows each command's output; the diagram shows the management group hierarchy, the baseline initiative and the SAP subscription.
Each command takes a minute or two; the clock moves only when you act or wait.
When you close, you write the record and explain your reasoning.

source.note: The HANA installation starts at 20:30, 90 minutes after the failure.

writeup.question: For the record: why the deployment was denied, what exception you made and why that shape, and what replaces it.

parts.label: Why
parts.criteria: Names the definition and its scope.
parts.modelAnswer: The error named corp-baseline / allowedVmSkus: the initiative assigned to the Corp management group allows 31 sizes and no M-series, so the HANA VMs were denied. Roles do not matter to a deny effect.

parts.label: Exception
parts.criteria: Narrow in rule, scope and time, with approval.
parts.modelAnswer: With the governance chair's approval, a Waiver exemption on rg-sap-prd for allowedVmSkus only, expiring in 30 days. Tagging and locations still apply. Deleting the assignment would have removed the baseline from 40 subscriptions.

parts.label: Replacement
parts.modelAnswer: A pull request adds the SAP-certified M-series sizes for the SAP landing zone to corp-baseline, so the waiver can expire.

expertPath.text: Error: corp-baseline / allowedVmSkus; the assignment's list has no M-series; nothing else non-compliant; governance group holds exempt rights.
Approved Waiver for allowedVmSkus on rg-sap-prd, 30 days; deploy; PR for the parameter.
Both VMs M64s; compliance shows the exemption.

baselineGone.headline: One rule blocked; forty were removed
baselineGone.body: Exempt the one definition for the one scope that needs it, with an end date and an approver. Deleting an assignment at a management group removes it from everything below.

rehearsalSlipped.headline: A policy deny is not a permissions problem
rehearsalSlipped.body: Azure Policy evaluates the resource, not the caller's role. Use an exemption on the assignment (or change its parameters) through whoever owns it.

waived.headline: Good: the narrowest exception, on the record
waived.body: You found the one definition that denied the size, asked its owner, exempted only that rule for only that scope with an expiry, checked compliance, and raised the change that makes the waiver unnecessary.

gaps.headline: Held, with gaps
gaps.body: The criteria show what was left: the evidence before the change, the lasting step, the check, or the cause in the record.

time_up.headline: Time up
time_up.body: No record was written before the run's hard limit.

scoring.modelReasoning: The deployment is denied by one definition in the baseline initiative, the allowed VM sizes list, assigned to the whole Corp management group. A policy deny does not care about the caller's role. Ask the owner and create the narrowest exemption: a Waiver for that definition only, on the SAP resource group only, with an expiry and the approval recorded. Deleting the assignment removes the baseline from every subscription. Then raise the parameter change so the waiver can expire.
